readme.text:
ClashMac 27

Native Proxy Experience Built for macOS

🌐 Official Website      📖 User Manual

## ✨ Features ### 🗺️ Visual Route Map - **Live Flight Routes**: Watch your active proxy traffic fly across the globe in real-time, updating every 10 seconds. - **Interactive Control**: Zoom, pan, and hover over paths for instant telemetry. Supports historical audit logs. - **Smart Obfuscation**: Mask your precise location by randomizing your departure point across 190+ global cities. ### 🔍 Active Connections & Rules - **Live Traffic Grid**: Check which apps are consuming bandwidth, their speeds, protocols, and routing rules. - **One-Click Rule Maker**: Instantly add custom proxy or blocking rules for the active browser tab or process. - **Instant Cut-off**: Disconnect any hogging connection with a simple right-click. ### 📊 Real-time Dashboard - **Speed Curves**: High-definition, smooth graph tracking upload and download bandwidth over a 60-second window. - **Leaderboards**: Automatically lists your most active target domains, matched rules, and destinations. - **Resource Monitoring**: Track system memory footprint of both the UI and the underlying network engine. ### 🌐 Anti-Detect Fingerprint Browser - **GeoIP Alignment**: Automatically aligns browser timezone, language, locale, and User-Agent with the active proxy node to prevent tracking and cross-region leaks. - **Multi-Profile Isolation**: Configure independent browser profiles with isolated cookies, cache, and dedicated proxy endpoints. - **Menu Bar Quick Access**: Launch or terminate target browser environments instantly from the macOS menu bar without opening the dashboard. - **Shared Extension Center**: Install Chrome extensions once via Web Store URL or ID—globally available across all fingerprint profiles. - **Built-in Status Page**: Start page displays real-time network connectivity, proxy exit IP geolocation, and extension shortcuts on launch. - **CDP Automation & CLI**: Automate browser workflows, capture full-page screenshots, evaluate scripts, and extract cookies via the `cm fp` command-line tool. --- ## 🛠️ Built for macOS - **100% Native**: Built exclusively in SwiftUI for native performance. Resides quietly in the menu bar with minimal CPU and memory footprints. - **TUN Enhanced**: System-wide proxy integration with complete UDP/TCP capture. - **No Setup Needed**: Ready out of the box with automated DNS, TUN, and routing database parameters. - **Video Boost**: Disable QUIC protocols to prevent ISP throttling and eliminate buffering on YouTube and Netflix. - **No Repeated Passwords**: Authorize network helper tool installation once—never get prompted for admin passwords again. --- ## 💻 Get Started - **System Requirement**: macOS 15.0+ (Sequoia or later) ### Installation 1. Download the latest `ClashMac.dmg` disk image from the [Releases page](https://github.com/666OS/ClashMac/releases/latest). 2. Double-click the `.dmg` and **drag** `ClashMac.app` into your **Applications** folder. > [!CAUTION] > Do not run ClashMac directly from the `.dmg` installer window, as macOS security sandbox will prevent the application from saving settings and installing system network services. 3. On first launch, right-click `ClashMac.app` and select **Open**. ClashMac will register its system helper tool and automatically download the correct kernel engine matching your Mac's CPU architecture (Apple Silicon or Intel). --- ## 🛡️ Bypassing Gatekeeper If macOS blocks launching with a warning (e.g., "developer cannot be verified"), use one of these solutions: - **System Settings**: Go to **System Settings** $\rightarrow$ **Privacy & Security**, scroll down to find the block notice, and click **Open Anyway**. - **Terminal Command**: Run the following command in Terminal to clear the quarantine flag: ```bash sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine /Applications/ClashMac.app ``` --- ## 🔒 Security & Privacy - **100% Local**: All settings, traffic details, and history stay locally on your Mac. No data collection, tracking, or logs. - **Secure Helper**: The background system helper is hardened and restricted to run core files solely from `/Applications/ClashMac.app/`. --- ## 📄 License & Credits ClashMac is proprietary, closed-source software. Binary releases are provided in this repository. View third-party credits and licenses here: 👉 [THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES](https://github.com/666OS/ClashMac/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt)

Crafted with ❤️ for macOS

releases.name: ClashMac 27.1.4
releases.body:
### 性能提升
- 修复海量规则下搜索过滤、退格及页面切换时的卡死问题
- 修复大量连接历史下持续开启面板导致的 CPU 偏高与内存异常占用
- 降低概览页面及后台常驻时的磁盘读写频率

### 系统适配与体验优化
- 修复日志等级未本地化翻译的问题，并加宽筛选下拉框避免文字截断
- 补全智能旁路位置权限指引、连接状态标签等文案的简体中文翻译，消除中英文混杂
- 适配新版 macOS 权限机制，解决无法识别当前 Wi-Fi 名称导致智能旁路失效的问题
- 修复新系统下流量图表数值文字与内容重叠的显示问题
- 简化侧边栏列表，引擎入口聚合

### 指纹浏览器
- 自动根据节点 IP 归属地对齐时区、语言及 User-Agent，防止指纹泄漏
- 支持多环境参数隔离与专属节点配置，面板与菜单栏均可一键极速启停
- 扩展一次安装全环境通用，支持粘贴 Chrome 商店链接或 ID 快捷安装更新
- 启动即显内置主页，直观展示网络连通性、出口 IP 与快捷扩展入口

### ClashMac CLI
- 新增超短指令别名 `cm`（通过设置面板重装或运行 `cm install` 激活）
- 提供 `cm fp list / launch / stop` 快速管理指纹环境
- 提供 `cm fp goto / shot / eval / cookie` 等 CDP 浏览器自动化调试指令

#### 反馈

* **功能手册**：查阅 [正式版发布日志](https://github.com/666OS/ClashMac/releases/latest) 或 [用户手册](https://clashmac.app/guide/) 了解核心功能
* **问题反馈**：如遇运行异常，请提交至 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/666OS/ClashMac/issues) 或关注 [Telegram 频道](https://t.me/Pinched666)

releases.name: ClashMac Alpha
releases.body:
## ClashMac Alpha 开发者预览版

本页面提供高频迭代的 Alpha 测试构建，用于快速验证实验性特性与 Bug 修复。

### 新增特性
- **年度活跃热力图**：移除原「流量时间轴」卡片，全新上线点阵热力图，直观展示全年流量消耗与活跃轨迹。

### 体验与性能优化
- **流量数据智能管理**：年度统计与热力图永久保存，自动轮替清理 30 天前的详细明细，长期使用轻量不占磁盘。
- **更清晰的数据清理**：支持“仅清空连接明细（保留统计）”与“重置全部数据”，管理更灵活安全。
- **流畅度与资源占用优化**：大幅降低菜单栏刷新开销，改进后台通信稳定性，界面交互更轻快。

### 安装与安全解锁

1. **拖拽安装**：双击 DMG 并将 `ClashMac.app` 拖入 `/Applications`。
2. **绕过系统阻止**（测试版未公证，首次打开如受阻，请在终端执行）：
   ```bash
   xattr -cr /Applications/ClashMac.app
   ```
3. **授权启动**：首次接管网络时，需根据系统提示输入一次密码以激活辅助特权服务。

### 参与测试与反馈

* **功能手册**：查阅 [正式版发布日志](https://github.com/666OS/ClashMac/releases/latest) 或 [用户手册](https://clashmac.app/guide/) 了解核心功能。
* **问题反馈**：如遇运行异常，请提交至 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/666OS/ClashMac/issues) 或关注 [Telegram 频道](https://t.me/Pinched666)。
